instruction: The owner explicitly requested release of the implemented Navrang 0.9.3 candidate on 10 November 2026 after the reported test results and limitations.
deviceEvidence: The original-key-signed 0.9.3 APK upgraded published 0.9.2 in place on the dedicated Android API 37 emulator, retaining the app ID, app data directory and original install time. Both versions launched.
publicationInstruction: Publish Navrang 0.9.3 using the existing release channel and original signing identity.
